blend.note: a NEW emergent culture, neither Celtic nor Woodland - deep-forest clans of grove and longhouse-rath, druid-and-faithkeeper spirit-lore; the tongue, titles and gods are fused forms (Celtic -an/lenition + Iroquoian long -onon, light on labials).

_note: Cross-family DEEP BLEND (Celtic + Woodland): a single emergent people of the deep forest - matrilineal-leaning clans of the grove and the longhouse-rath, their spirit-keepers fusing the druid and the faithkeeper. Not backbone+overlay: the lexicon, titles and deity-names are genuinely fused (Celtic softness + Iroquoian long compounds, sparse in labials). clan = clanhold. Seeds/shifts Neutral or Chaotic. Common-word lexicon and rank titles fuse the real Gaelic/Iroquois registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are fused morphs of the Agrippan canon, never real gods. [REWORKED 2026-06-27 to the base/hybrid model: csv_id HYB_19; all human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic; ruler/domain DISPLAY titles now English (or an approved foreign term), the fused conlang titles moved to ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue; worship_by_alignment completed to all three. Deep-fusion blend, lexicon, deities (canonical Agrippan morphs) and name stock retained from the v1 kit.]

phonology.palette: Fused Celtic-Iroquoian: soft, vowel-rich, sparse in labials; lenition (c>ch, t>th) meets long polysynthetic compounds; consonants t k s h n r w y, ts, ch, glottal stop; endings fuse Celtic -an/-ach with Iroquoian -onon/-wenne.
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC; few labials; glottal stops; long compounds.

fusion_rules.lean: deep fusion (Celtic-Iroquoian), balanced; soft, labial-sparse, long compounds
sound_changes: Celtic root + Iroquoian root weld into one long stem; neither parent dominates - the Celtic onset carries an Iroquoian polysynthetic tail (aub+yon>aubyon, loch+kanota>lochkanota, sruth+wisken>sruthwisken)
Iroquoian long compounding governs word length: fused stems run long and agglutinative, stacking -onon/-onta/-enrak/-wira/-wenne/-anota onto the Celtic head
Celtic lenition softens the seam (c>ch, t>th): cathair>cathironon, cnoc>cnononta, both/bothar>bothaha
labial-sparse - p/b/m thinned at the join; Celtic labials drop or open into the vowel-rich Iroquoian body (dubh>dub- kept but rare, marsh moin- light)
glottal stops and vowel hiatus tolerated inside the long compound rather than collapsed (bothaha, caolawa, muinyara)
signature phonemes from both stay audible - Celtic loch-/sruth-/dun-/rath-/cath- onsets and Iroquoian -onon/-onta/-wira/-kanota/-tehron finals
fusion_rules.source_tilt: land/terrain/water/staple roots take a Celtic head and an Iroquoian compounding tail, welded inseparably (Celtic loch/sruth/cnoc/dun + Iroquoian -kanota/-wisken/-ononta/-onon); a balanced deep fusion, not a substrate under a prestige register, with the Iroquoian side driving length and the labial-sparse shape

morphology.patronymic_form: the finawachira (matrilineal clan, by animal-totem) names through the clan-mother (fusing the Celtic fine and the Iroquoian ohwachira); a grove-vision name at the coming-of-age.
morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|totem](stem) + element: Dub-fidkaron (black-deep-forest), Nemed-Toranon (grove of the sun-power); clan-totem + -onon.

title_ladder.government: clanhold (deep-forest clans bound by a grove-council: the clan-mothers seat the chiefs, the spirit-keepers read the grove; peace-chiefs and war-chiefs distinct)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Fused Celtic-Iroquoian clanhold, ascending; titles blend the two (Celtic aire/toisech/flaith/ri + Iroquoian royaner/rotiskenrakehte/tadodaho). Aironer (clan-lord) barony; Maoresken (war-warden) march; Toisoner (sept-chief) county; Flaitoken (lord) duchy; Rinakenra (king-sachem) principality; Ruironon (over-chief) kingdom; Ardonaho (high-chief / grand firekeeper) empire. The clan-mothers seat and may depose the chiefs; the grove-council rules by consensus. (Rank titles fuse the real Gaelic/Iroquois register, allowed.)
title_ladder.heir: Tanaiste-ase (the clan-mother's chosen heir; the title is conferred within the clan)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

female_forms_native._clan_mother: Banakenra / Iakoia:ner (clan-mother - seats and deposes the chiefs)

people_name_convention.order: names belong to the matrilineal finawachira (clan, by totem) and are bestowed by the clan-mother; a grove-vision name at coming-of-age; a deed byname for the renowned.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the chief-lineages bear council title-names; others a clan-totem name held in trust.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names invoke the grove-and-forest powers + a fused element: Mael-/Gilla- (devotee/servant), -onon, Cu- (hound): e.g. Mael-Toranon, Gilla-Gaianon.

religion._note: Deity-names are fused morphs of the Agrippan canon (Celtic + Iroquoian), never real Celtic/Iroquois gods. Senecar seeds/shifts Neutral or Chaotic; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The powers are met in the nemed-grove and the deep forest; the spirit-keepers (fused druid-and-faithkeeper) mediate; the ancestral dead and the Tuath-spirits are honored at the cairn and the burial-grove.
religion.the_one: Eteronon (< Aeternus; fused Celtic Eternan / Iroquoian Aterhonon) - the Sky-Ancient-Above; acknowledged and set aside (Neutral), reviled as the far tyrant when Chaotic

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Toranon (the sun, the day-keeper; Lawful power)
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gaianon (the enduring earth and forest; Lawful power)
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Realwen (the mother, clan-mother of the powers; Neutral-honored)

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: Venerates the Lawful powers of the canon - Eteronon foremost - and names the Chaotic powers as demons to be warded.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent - somewhat honored, somewhat feared; foreground the ancestral dead, the Tuath-spirits and the powers of grove and forest
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerate the Chaotic powers (Marakson the war-fire, Wasidonon, Rusanon), demonize the Lawful powers and the One (Eteronon)

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (the Lawful powers + the One, when Chaotic) take dread epithets: Tulrius -> Toranon the Cold-Light; Orlandus -> Oranlon the Oath-Chain; Aeternus -> Eteronon the Far Tyrant.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Nemedonon (grove-shrine) of [power] in the deep forest: 'the Nemedonon of Toranon'; the thanksgiving-circle of the clans.
religion.saints_pattern: the Tuath-spirits (the god-kin and forest-spirits) and the honored clan-mothers and ancestral heroes, kept in the grove-recital.

holy_symbol_motifs.Toranon: a sun-wheel over the longhouse and the oak
holy_symbol_motifs.Gaianon: a great forest-tree rooted in the earth
holy_symbol_motifs.Realwen: a sheltering mother over the planted field

banks_patterns.ships: forest river and lake craft - curach and bark canoe: 'the Grey Heron', 'the River-Otter', 'Forest-Shadow'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [clan-totem] Fian-warriors / the war-party: 'the Wolf-Fian', 'the Hawk war-party'
banks_patterns.taverns: the council-longhouse and the grove-feast: 'the Great Longhouse', 'the Oak and Salmon'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: abandoned raths and burial-groves: 'the Rath of [name]', 'the Ghost-Longhouse of [clan]'
